Module System.Dynamic module registry: ModuleManager discovers, loads and registers every pluggable module type (pages, widgets, fields, members, managers, daemons, connectors, actions, providers, behaviors, environments, highlighters, utils) and exposes them by type/name lookup.
Module System.Module type controllers: Each module type has a ModulesController subclass declaring its load path, base class, whether it is class-based, and a human-readable description, so new module types can be added by dropping in a controller module.
Module System.Source module discovery: Recursively walks a package path with pkgutil, imports each module, extracts its registered class and upserts the source code into the modules DB table as the source of truth.
Module System.Plugin module discovery: Scans src/plugins/*/<type>/ (and mirrored dotted paths) so any plugin can contribute modules of any registered type, with plugin modules taking precedence over same-named core modules.
Module System.Database-backed virtual modules: Loads modules whose Python source is stored in the DB via a custom importlib loader (VirtualModuleLoader), executing them into synthetic sys.modules entries, gated by the system.allow_importing_db_modules setting.
Module System.Module baking and mirroring: Writes DB-stored module source back to a real .py file on disk (bake = marks baked=1 and imports normally; mirror = write-only for frozen builds) so IDEs and Claude Code can see real files.
Module System.Class-marking decorator: set_module_type tags a class with _ap_module_type (plus optional plugin/settings hints) so the extractor knows which class in a file is the module's entry point.
Module System.Module metadata extraction: Parses each module's source with ast to record its attributes, methods, classes, constructor params, superclass and super() kwargs, plus a config hash, into the DB metadata column.
Module System.Module enable/disable and scaffolding: Modules carry an enabled flag honoured at registry build time, and new modules can be created from per-controller initial_content templates.
Module System.Module test harness: test_all / test_scaffold runs per-module smoke tests (e.g. the Pages controller navigates to each page, asserts visibility and invokes test_page / test_widget hooks) and returns pass/skip/fail with tracebacks.

System Managers.BaseManager pattern: A dict subclass backed by a DB table that provides load/add/delete/save, automatic table definition, pinned/order-aware ordering, default fields and folder support — the base for every manager and module controller.
System Managers.SystemManager: The root object that instantiates ModuleManager, discovers all Managers modules and attaches them as attributes, loads them in order on startup, and can relaunch the app process.
System Managers.Config manager: Loads the JSON app config from the settings table and persists it back automatically on every key set or delete.
System Managers.Daemon manager: Discovers daemon classes from the module registry, starts each as a named asyncio task, exposes read-only views of available and running daemons, and supports stop/restart/start-all/stop-all with crash logging and bookkeeping cleanup.
System Managers.Async daemon protocol: Daemons implement start() / stop() (sync or awaitable) and are wrapped so cancellation and exceptions are logged and instances are always deregistered.

Database.SQLite connector: Thread-locked SQLite connector providing execute, batched execute_many in a single transaction, get_results with multiple return shapes, and scalar fetch with optional JSON parsing.
Database.Table auto-definition: define_table creates a standard table (id, auto-generated UUIDv4, name, kind, config, relations) on demand so managers and plugins can declare their storage lazily.
Database.SQL facade: utils.sql wraps the active connector with module-level execute/get_results/get_scalar helpers, DB path resolution, and DB file copy/export.
Database.Schema migration: SQLUpgrade applies versioned migrations (0.1.0 through 0.6.0) after backing up data.db, with ensure_column_in_tables for additive column changes.
Database.Application reset / bootstrap: reset_application rebuilds the database and config from scratch, re-seeds system folders and models, with a guard preventing forced reset of the main data.db.
Database.Decimal adapter: Registers a sqlite3 adapter so Decimal values can be passed directly as query parameters.

Undo / Actions System.Undoable action framework: A pluggable Actions module type where each action stores JSON-serialisable data and implements undo/redo, recorded onto a 50-entry undo stack.
Undo / Actions System.Persistent undo history: Undo and redo stacks are serialised to the undo_history settings row on every record and reloaded on startup, with a guard against overwriting stored history before load.
Undo / Actions System.Action merging: Consecutive same-type actions can absorb the previous entry (e.g. per-keystroke config edits within a 5-second window merge into one undo step).
Undo / Actions System.Grouped action capture: A capture() context manager collects recorded entries instead of pushing them, so several writes can be wrapped into one composite action (e.g. SaveChatEntityAction).
Undo / Actions System.Replay guarding: A _replaying flag plus replay_guard prevents undo/redo from recording spurious new actions, and replay failures are swallowed so they can't kill the Qt event loop.
Undo / Actions System.Config save action: Records before/after values of a table item save and reapplies them, then refreshes any visible widget bound to that table and item.
Undo / Actions System.Navigate action: Records changes of the current page path (pages, tabs, tree selections) so navigation can be undone and redone.
Undo / Actions System.Undo labels: next_undo_label / next_redo_label expose the human-readable label of the next action for menu display.

Utilities.Path resolution: get_application_path, simplify_path and unsimplify_path resolve the app root for both source and frozen builds and convert between portable and absolute paths.
Utilities.Media helpers: Detect media type from extension, choose preview classes/icons, play files (with optional blocking, partial-wait and interrupt), estimate durations and stop playback.
Utilities.FFmpeg-backed timeline rendering: media_export composites clips into video frames, renders timeline audio with automatic offset alignment, and exports the combined result.
Utilities.Process restart: Computes the correct relaunch command and environment (accounting for debugger and frozen builds) and respawns the application.
Utilities.Parameter schema conversion: params_to_schema converts stored param definitions into a JSON schema suitable for LLM function calling.
Utilities.JSON and hashing helpers: try_parse_json, get_json_value, hash_config (with exclusions) and model-JSON to object conversion.
Utilities.Avatar and pixmap helpers: Compose circular avatars from one or more image paths with sizing, opacity and default-avatar fallback.
Utilities.Message and dialog helpers: display_message (transient toast) and display_message_box (modal with custom buttons) for user-facing notifications from core code.
Utilities.Qt signal blocking: A block_signals context manager that suppresses signals across widgets and optionally their children.
Utilities.Network check: network_connected reports connectivity before attempting remote calls.
Utilities.Naming helpers: convert_to_safe_case normalises names for use as table names, module names and file slugs.
Utilities.Baked item loading: get_all_baked_items reads YAML/JSON-defined seed records off disk for tables that ship with bundled defaults.

Application Shell.Frameless resizable window: The main window is frameless and translucent with a custom mouse-driven resize/move mixin (FramelessResizeMixin) that changes the cursor at window edges.
Application Shell.Custom title bar: A floating title button bar in the top-right provides minimize, maximize/restore and close buttons since the native frame is hidden.
Application Shell.Always-on-top toggle: The window can be pinned above all other windows, driven by the system.always_on_top setting and re-applied live without a restart.
Application Shell.Persistent window size: Resizing the window writes width/height into the window_size setting so the app reopens at the same size, positioned at the bottom-right of the screen.
Application Shell.Restored page path on startup: The last-selected page path is saved in the page_path setting and reselected when the app relaunches.
Application Shell.Undo/redo with history menu: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z application shortcuts plus a '⋮' button open a menu showing the next undo/redo action labels from the core action history.
Application Shell.Toast notifications: A NotificationManager stacks fading, auto-dismissing notification cards in the corner of the window, with hover-to-persist and click-to-close behaviour.
Application Shell.System tray icon: A tray icon is registered so the app can raise native desktop notifications and stay resident.
Application Shell.Drag-and-drop file attach: Dropping files onto the main window forwards their paths to the chat page's attachment bar.
Application Shell.Terms-of-service gate: On first run a TOS dialog must be accepted before the app is usable; acceptance is stored in settings.
Application Shell.Database check and migration: On startup the app verifies the database exists, upgrades its version, and runs recursive config patch/rename migrations across tables.
Application Shell.Daemon lifecycle on startup/shutdown: Background daemons are auto-started shortly after launch and stopped (with timeout) when the window closes.
Application Shell.Recent-chat side bubbles: A popup strip of circular avatar buttons for the three most recent chats can slide out beside the main window and auto-hides when the mouse leaves.
Application Shell.Page load error reporting: Pages that fail to import are caught individually, recorded with a traceback, and reported via a warning dialog instead of crashing the app.

Navigation.Icon sidebar page navigation: MainPages renders all 'main' and pinned page modules as a right-hand vertical icon sidebar with 'chat' as the default page.
Navigation.Dynamic page discovery: Pages are loaded at runtime from the modules table by module type 'Pages', so pages can be added, edited or removed without touching the shell.
Navigation.Page pinning: Pages declared as type 'any' can be pinned from the sidebar context menu to move them between the main sidebar and the settings sidebar.
Navigation.Preferred/locked page ordering: Core pages (chat, contexts, agents, blocks, tools, projects, files, tasks) are ordered first and settings is locked to the bottom of the sidebar.
Navigation.Add new page: An 'add page' action prompts for a name, creates a new Pages module, pins it, selects it and opens it in the page editor.
Navigation.Breadcrumb trail: A BreadcrumbWidget shows the current nesting path with a back button, inline title renaming, and an agent-visualisation preview on hover.
Navigation.Page disabling: The sidebar context menu can disable a page module so it no longer appears.

Pages.Settings: A nested ConfigPages hub that hosts every 'settings'-type page module (system, display, models, roles, blocks, tools, modules...) and persists them into the app_config settings row.
Pages.System settings: Lets the user set language, dev mode, always-on-top, multi-window, DB module imports, auto-bake, auto-run tools/code, voice input method, default chat/voice/image/video/audio models, auto-title behaviour and prompt, and the default project entity.
Pages.Display settings: Lets the user pick or save/delete named themes and tune primary/secondary/accent/link/text colours, font and size, bubble collapsing ratio, bubble name/avatar/waiting-bar visibility, bubble spacing, window margin and workflow view.
Pages.Modules: A DB-backed tree of code modules where the user can add, delete, folder-organise, describe, avatar, load/run, unload, bake and edit each module's Python source and data.
Pages.Page editor: A snap-to-side frameless editor window for a page module that embeds an application-project widget for editing the page's files, with a reload-modules button that rebuilds all pages in place.
Pages.Daemons: Lists daemon modules scanned off disk with live status (Running/Stopped/Disabled/Not loaded) and buttons to start, stop, restart, enable or disable each one.
Pages.Files: Embeds the full file browser (FileTree) as a main page for browsing, previewing and managing files on disk.

Widget Framework.ConfigWidget base: Common base giving every widget schema building, config load/save to the DB, namespaced config propagation to parents, breadcrumb updating and page-map tracking.
Widget Framework.ConfigFields: Renders a declarative schema list into labelled form rows, supporting row grouping, left/top labels, auto label width, tooltips (help icons), per-field toggle checkboxes, readonly, visibility and stretch options.
Widget Framework.ConfigJoined: Stacks several config widgets vertically or horizontally into one combined config surface.
Widget Framework.ConfigPages: A collection widget that renders child pages behind a sidebar of buttons (icon or text), supporting right-to-left and bottom-to-top layouts and page pinning.
Widget Framework.ConfigTabs: A collection widget that renders child pages as a tab bar.
Widget Framework.ConfigSideTabs: A splitter-based layout with collapsible, titled sections instead of tabs.
Widget Framework.ConfigTree: Base tree widget with add/delete/new-folder/filter toolbar buttons, optional search, filtering, versioning, infinite scroll loading, folder config widget, and a splitter between tree and config pane.
Widget Framework.ConfigDBTree: Database-backed tree providing item add/delete/rename/duplicate/pin, folder creation and nesting, drag-and-drop reparenting, kind grouping, live search filtering, per-item config saving, bake/unbake, version history and unread notification badges.
Widget Framework.ConfigJsonTree: Tree whose rows are stored as a JSON list in the parent config, with inline editable cells and add/remove row buttons.
Widget Framework.ConfigJsonDBTree: Tree that stores a JSON list of references to rows in a database table, rendering each with an icon.
Widget Framework.ConfigExtTree: Async variant of ConfigJsonTree that fetches its rows on a worker thread and pushes them back via a Qt signal.
Widget Framework.ConfigVoiceTree: A read-only DB tree of TTS voices grouped by API provider.
Widget Framework.ConfigTable: A QTableView-based config surface with a schema-driven model, editable cells, selection by id and add/delete/rename hooks.
Widget Framework.BaseTreeWidget: Shared tree implementation providing schema-derived columns, in-cell widgets, folder branch drawing, nested-folder grouping, tooltips, multi-select by id, and drag-drop that updates folder/parent/kind in the DB.
Widget Framework.Inline widget editing mode: An EditBar can be attached to any config widget to swap its base widget class, edit its field options, and add/delete pages — rewriting the underlying module source.
Widget Framework.TreeDialog and LibraryDialog: Modal pickers for selecting an existing DB item or browsing the entity/agent library, used by fields that reference other records.
Widget Framework.CustomMenu toolbar/menubar builder: Builds toolbars, menu bars and popup menus from a declarative schema with icons, checkable actions, and visibility/enabled predicates evaluated at show time.
Widget Framework.Config presets: A preset menu button saves the current widget's config under a name and re-applies or deletes saved presets later.

Fields.Text field: Single- or multi-line text input with configurable line count, font size, alignment, monospace, transparency, placeholder text and readonly mode.
Fields.Code editor (CTextEdit): Multi-line editor with code folding for XML and Python, indent/dedent, tab handling, drag-and-drop text, and an expand button that opens the text in a standalone editor window.
Fields.Jinja block suggestions: Typing inside {{ }} in a text field pops up an autocomplete list of available blocks.
Fields.AI text enhancement: A wand button next to text fields runs a chosen 'enhancement block' against the field's content and streams the rewritten text back in, with a right-click menu to assign or remove blocks.
Fields.Integer field: Numeric spinner with min/max, step and optional value snapping.
Fields.Float field: Double spinner with configurable decimals, range and step; wheel scrolling is suppressed.
Fields.Boolean field: A checkbox field mapped to a true/false config value.
Fields.Combo field: A combobox with a type-to-filter popup, grouped non-selectable headers, DB-table-backed item loading, and wheel-scroll suppression.
Fields.Font picker: A combobox listing system fonts rendered in their own typeface.
Fields.Color picker: A button that opens the colour dialog and stores the picked hex colour, showing it as the button's swatch.
Fields.File picker: A line edit plus browse button for choosing a file or directory path.
Fields.Image / avatar field: A circular image label that opens a file dialog to change the avatar, with a settings popup for its options.
Fields.Media upload: Uploads an image/audio/video file (or inserts a clip from the studio's collection), previews it inline, and can encode it to base64 for the resolved model provider.
Fields.List field: A repeatable list of sub-fields with add/remove buttons and drag-handle reordering.
Fields.Model combobox: Selects an AI model, showing provider-grouped options plus an options button that expands model parameter fields inline.
Fields.Module combobox: Selects a module of a given type from the modules table.
Fields.Entity field: Shows an agent/entity avatar and name and opens the library dialog to browse and pick or link an entity.
Fields.Member type menu: An icon button menu for choosing a workflow member type (agent, block, tool, etc.), including opening the library to insert existing members.
Fields.Project type menu: An icon button menu for choosing the project type of a project.
Fields.Venv combobox: Selects a Python virtual environment, with reset and hover affordances.
Fields.Input source / target comboboxes: Paired comboboxes that pick a workflow input's source structure and its target parameter, updating available options dynamically.
Fields.Button and toggle-button fields: Schema-declarable action buttons and checkable toggle buttons that run a target callable.
Fields.Popup buttons: Icon buttons that open a floating popup for member settings, model settings, or an input condition expression.
Fields.Field options editor: Every field exposes an option_schema, and an options gear button lets the user edit that field's properties while in widget-edit mode.
Fields.Add-field control: In edit mode a trailing 'add field' row lets the user append a new field of a chosen type to a form, writing it into the module source.

File Browser.Lazy directory model: A custom QAbstractItemModel streams directory entries in batches so very large folders open without blocking the UI.
File Browser.Navigation panel: A left panel with a bookmarks list (home, desktop, documents, etc.) and a folder tree, with a toggle for showing files in the tree.
File Browser.Path bar with history: An editable path bar plus back/forward/up buttons with a navigation history stack.
File Browser.Multiple view modes: The file view switches between list/detail-style presentations and supports name filtering.
File Browser.File operations: Context menus provide open, rename, delete (to trash), copy, cut, paste with automatic unique-name resolution, and new-folder creation.
File Browser.File preview tabs: Selected files open in preview tabs, dispatching to the studio widget registered for that file extension.
File Browser.Properties dialog: Shows a file or folder's metadata, with directory sizes computed asynchronously.
File Browser.Status bar: Displays the selection count and total size of selected items for the current directory.

Media Previews.Image preview: Displays an image scaled to a default size with click-to-toggle zoom to full size.
Media Previews.Video preview: A QMediaPlayer-backed player with play/pause, a seek slider and a duration label.
Media Previews.Audio preview: Shows the filename with a play button that plays the file through the media helper.

Collections.Collections widget: A tree of media collection folders and clips stored on disk, with add, delete, rename and folder creation.
Collections.Global collections: Folders can be marked global so they are shared across projects, stored separately in settings.
Collections.Drag out to insert: Collection items can be dragged out of the tree to insert them elsewhere in the app.

Theming & Display.Runtime stylesheet generation: The whole Qt stylesheet is generated from the display config (primary, secondary, text, accent colours and text size) and re-applied live when settings change.
Theming & Display.Contrast safeguard: If the text colour is too close to the background in RGB distance, it is forced to pure white or black so text stays readable.
Theming & Display.Icon recolouring: Icons are colourised to the active text colour and every IconButton, tree and chart is refreshed when the theme colour changes.
Theming & Display.Named themes: The current colour set can be saved as a named theme in the themes table, re-selected from a dropdown, or deleted (duplicates are rejected).
Theming & Display.Window margin control: A display setting adjusts the main layout's content margins around the frameless window.
Theming & Display.Chat bubble appearance settings: Display settings control bubble spacing, name and avatar visibility, the waiting bar, and automatic collapsing of over-long bubbles by a configurable ratio.

Syntax Highlighting.Python highlighter: Colourises Python keywords, builtins, strings, numbers, decorators and comments in .py content.
Syntax Highlighting.JSON highlighter: Colourises keys, string/number values and the true/false/null literals for json, jsonc, jsonl and json5.
Syntax Highlighting.XML highlighter: Colourises XML tags and attributes and additionally highlights Jinja2 {{ }} expressions and tags.
Syntax Highlighting.CEL highlighter: Colourises keywords, operators, builtins and strings in CEL condition expressions.
Syntax Highlighting.Extension-based highlighter selection: Each highlighter declares associated_extensions and is resolved dynamically from the modules registry, so highlighters can be added as modules.

Module Builder.AST source rewriting: builder.py uses ast/astor to modify a module's Python source in place — changing a class's base class, adding or deleting nested page classes, and adding schema fields.
Module Builder.Field option schemas: Common field option schemas drive the generated code for newly added fields, mapping friendly type names to Python types.
Module Builder.Live module reload: After edits, modules are reloaded and page trees rebuilt while preserving the user's current page selections and tree expansion state.

Demo & Testing.Scripted UI demo: A demo runner drives the real UI on a worker thread with synthetic mouse moves, clicks, hovers and typed text against a throwaway copy of the database.
Demo & Testing.Demo overlay: A translucent always-on-top card shows the current demo segment, progress and narration text with a Stop button.
Demo & Testing.Automated widget tests: A background TestRunnable walks every module controller's test scaffold (optionally filtered to specific pages with --pages), prints a pass/fail/skip report, and exits with a non-zero code on failure.
Demo & Testing.Disposable test/demo database: Test and demo runs copy the live DB aside, reset and bootstrap a scratch database, then restore the user's real DB when finished.
Demo & Testing.Escape to abort: Pressing Escape during a scripted run clears the running flag to stop the demo or test.

Engine.Graph-based workflow model: A Workflow is a nested graph of members positioned by loc_x/loc_y with typed input edges; members are instantiated in dependency order and a workflow can itself be a member of another workflow.
Engine.Workflow execution behavior: DefaultBehavior repeatedly computes the set of members whose inputs are all satisfied and runs them — concurrently via asyncio.gather when several are ready, sequentially otherwise — until the turn completes.
Engine.Streaming output: Members are async generators yielding (role, chunk) pairs that propagate up through the workflow to the run manager and the attached chat widget for live token streaming.
Engine.Run manager: WorkflowRunManager tracks which contexts are currently running, routes streamed chunks to whichever widget currently displays that context, supports stop requests, and updates sidebar activity indicators.
Engine.Turn / alt-turn bookkeeping: Each run toggles an alt_turn_state and tracks per-member turn_output / last_output so partially completed turns, loops and re-entrant runs resolve correctly.
Engine.Loopers and conditional flow: Input edges can be marked as looper to feed output back upstream, and Condition/Probability/Iterate/Node members provide branching, randomised and iterative control flow.
Engine.CEL condition evaluation: evaluate_condition builds a context of member outputs and workflow params and evaluates a CEL-style expression to gate flow members.
Engine.Linked configs: Members and contexts can reference a linked_id pointing at a source entity (agent/block/tool), resolved at load time with circular-link detection and a visited set to prevent infinite expansion.
Engine.Config merging: merge_config_into_workflow_config normalises a bare single-entity config into a full workflow config, so any agent/block/tool can be run as a one-member workflow.
Engine.Programmatic workflow invocation: receive_workflow / compute_workflow_async / compute_workflow let any code run a workflow config headlessly and collect the streamed result, including from non-async threads via the main qasync loop.
Engine.Message history with branching: MessageHistory loads a conversation via recursive SQL over the contexts tree, following the active leaf branch, and supports branching/activating/deactivating alternate message paths.
Engine.Config templating: Member config values are rendered through Jinja before use, substituting block outputs, member outputs and workflow params.
Engine.Token counting: Each message computes a tiktoken token count on construction for context-window management.

Members.Agent: LLM conversation member with a composed system message, model config, tools, declared inputs/outputs and streaming response handling.
Members.User: User turn member that also handles microphone capture, discovering a downstream realtime agent and committing captured audio to it.
Members.Contact: Non-LLM participant representing an external contact in a conversation.
Members.Prompt: One-shot LLM block that sends a single rendered prompt rather than a message history.
Members.Text: Static/templated text block that emits its rendered content.
Members.Code: Executes code in a chosen language inside a selected environment/venv, wrapping the snippet with parameter bindings.
Members.Query: Runs SQL against the app database via execute / scalar / get-results with selectable return shapes.
Members.Notif: Shows a desktop/system notification with configurable title, icon, colour and duration.
Members.Wait: Sleeps for a configured duration in seconds, minutes or hours before continuing.
Members.SetVariable: Sets a workflow- or global-scoped variable, optionally ephemeral.
Members.Node: Plain flow node used as a junction in the member graph.
Members.Iterate: Loop member that repeats its downstream branch over an input collection.
Members.Probability: Randomly gates its branch based on a configured probability.
Members.Condition: Gates its branch on a CEL expression evaluated against member outputs and workflow variables.
Members.Image / Video / Audio: Media members that resolve a browse path, URL or generated result into a media output for downstream members.
Members.Tool calling: LlmMember builds function-call schemas from tool definitions, dispatches tool calls to the tool manager, and feeds results back as result messages.
Members.Structured output streaming: stream_structured_output streams a schema-constrained model response for members that need parsed JSON rather than free text.
Members.Role tag parsing: CharProcessor scans streamed characters for role tags (e.g. thinking/code/output) and re-routes chunks into the correct message role bubble.
Members.StreamSpeaker: Buffers streamed text into sentence-sized blocks and pushes them to TTS as the agent speaks.

Model Providers.Provider base: Common provider interface for running models, polling request status, fetching result media, and converting OpenAPI schemas into internal field schemas.
Model Providers.LitellmProvider: Routes chat completions through LiteLLM (so any LiteLLM-supported API works as a chat backend), including instructor-backed structured output and model-list syncing.
Model Providers.ReplicateProvider: Runs Replicate models with prediction polling, result and transcription retrieval, file upload and schema resolution across referenced schemas.
Model Providers.FalProvider: Runs fal.ai models with queued request status/result polling, file upload and $ref schema resolution.
Model Providers.WavespeedProvider: Runs WaveSpeed models with signed headers, request polling, upload and model syncing.
Model Providers.SeedanceProvider: Runs Seedance video tasks, resolving local media into data URIs or uploads and polling task state.
Model Providers.SonautoProvider: Runs Sonauto music generation with request polling, result retrieval and model syncing.
Model Providers.Async queued generation: Media providers submit a job, return a request id, and are polled for status, letting long-running image/video/audio generations run in the background.
Model Providers.Media generation manager: Tracks in-flight generations per studio/clip key, persists pending requests across restarts, polls providers on a timer, delivers finished files and reports status text.

Managers.ModelsManager: Loads models joined to their APIs, merges API config under model config, resolves API keys (including $ENV_VAR indirection), detects realtime speech-to-speech models and re-uploads media params whose hosted URLs expired.
Managers.APIManager: Stores API endpoints and credentials in the apis table with environment-variable key resolution, and cascades deletes to dependent models.
Managers.ProviderManager: Instantiates one live object per registered Provider module for the rest of the system to call.
Managers.AgentManager: CRUD over the entities table for saved agents, each stored as a workflow config.
Managers.BlockManager: Stores reusable named blocks, renders strings through an async Jinja environment with member-output/param placeholders, and can execute a block as a workflow.
Managers.ToolManager: Stores tool definitions, converts their params into JSON call schemas, and executes a tool as a workflow returning a JSON status/output envelope.
Managers.SkillsManager: Mirrors skill rows to Anthropic-format .claude/skills/<slug>/SKILL.md files on disk, parsing and reassembling frontmatter description plus body on read/write.
Managers.PlansManager: Mirrors plan rows to markdown files on disk with slugged filenames, supporting read/write/list/delete.
Managers.EnvironmentManager: Loads execution environments from the DB and instantiates the configured environment class (Docker, safe-integrated, or the default in-process exec).
Managers.VenvManager: Discovers virtual environments under the app's venvs folder and can create, list and delete new ones via python -m venv / pyenv, cross-platform.
Managers.RolesManager: Manages message roles and their display attributes.

Execution Environments.Docker environment: Pulls or builds an image, ensures a named container with port mappings, volume mounts and env vars, starts/stops it, tails logs, runs code inside it and cleans up.
Execution Environments.Safe integrated environment: Executes Python in-process with access to the app's system managers and sql module for code that needs to drive the app itself.
Execution Environments.Default environment: Compiles and execs code inline while capturing stdout, returning the captured output as the member's result.
Execution Environments.Environment variables: Environments can carry configured env vars applied when the environment is updated.

Realtime Voice.RealtimeSession: Websocket session for realtime speech-to-speech models — connect, send audio, commit, clear input, create/cancel response and read the event stream.
Realtime Voice.AudioHandler: Qt audio capture and playback of PCM with a drain loop plus WAV read/write helpers.
Realtime Voice.LocalVAD: Local voice-activity detection over incoming PCM frames used to decide when to commit a user turn.
Realtime Voice.Realtime workflow sessions: LlmMember can open an OpenAI Realtime websocket session, stream microphone PCM, handle server VAD and barge-in, persist transcripts, and tear sessions down cleanly on workflow close.

Pages.Chat: Main chat page built on the chattable workflow widget.
Pages.Agents: Agent tree whose config widget is a full workflow editor.
Pages.Blocks: Blocks tree with a chattable workflow config widget per block.
Pages.Tools: Tools tree with a chattable workflow config widget per tool.
Pages.Models: Models tree with per-kind tabs (chat, image, video, audio, etc.) and API/parameter configuration.
Pages.Environments: Environments tree with Docker-specific image, container lifecycle, port, volume and env-var sections.
Pages.Skills: Skills tree kept in two-way sync with <slug>/SKILL.md files via filesystem watching.
Pages.Plans: Plans tree pairing a markdown editor with a Claude Code chat that edits the selected plan file, with disk-change reconciliation.
Pages.Goals: Goals tree where each goal owns a Claude Code chat whose cwd tracks the goal, plus a Run button; goals can be created from a chat message.

Chat UI.ChattableWorkflowWidget: Reusable widget embedding a workflow plus its chat transcript, input bar and run controls.
Chat UI.ChatInputWidget: Input area that adapts to the next expected member — showing text+send for user turns and a standalone send button otherwise.
Chat UI.AttachmentBar: Attaches files/media to the outgoing message.
Chat UI.Voice capture control: Starts/stops microphone capture on the next expected User member.
Chat UI.Goal command: Interprets /goal <name> in a Claude Code chat as a goal creation/switch command.
Chat UI.MessageCollection: Scrollable transcript managing message containers, bubble grouping, a 'waiting for' bar and refresh on context change.
Chat UI.MessageContainer: Per-message row holding avatar, bubble and a button bar with edit, screenshot, resend, branch and promote-to-goal actions.
Chat UI.CountdownButton: Button that auto-triggers after a visible countdown.

Bubbles.MessageBubble base: QTextEdit-based bubble with markdown rendering, code-block extraction with language detection, per-role styling lookup and branch navigation buttons.
Bubbles.Role bubbles: Distinct bubbles for user, assistant, system, instruction, output, result, thinking and goal messages.
Bubbles.CodeBubble: Code message bubble with a rerun button.
Bubbles.ToolBubble: Tool call bubble showing editable parameters, a rerun button and a go-to-tool button.
Bubbles.ImageBubble / VideoBubble / AudioBubble: Media bubbles embedding image previews, a video player and an audio player respectively.

Member Settings Widgets.WorkflowSettings: The workflow graph editor — a QGraphicsView canvas of member nodes and input links with drag-to-connect, circular-reference checks, a member list, compact mode and a save-as menu for agents/blocks/tools/tasks.
Member Settings Widgets.AgentSettings: Agent config tabs for messages, preloaded messages, tools, variables and voice.
Member Settings Widgets.UserSettings / ContactSettings: Config fields for user and contact members.
Member Settings Widgets.MediaSettings family: Shared base for Image/Video/Audio settings with browse, URL and generate tabs, including yt-dlp download for video and audio URLs.
Member Settings Widgets.GenerateWidget: Generate button that resolves timeline/clip source references into uploads and runs the selected model through the generation manager.
Member Settings Widgets.MultiPreview: Single-row multi-result preview strip that displays generated media, shows generation status, supports selecting and 'using' a result, and resumes saved polling.
Member Settings Widgets.InputSettings: Editor for a member input's conditional expression and mapped fields.
Member Settings Widgets.Per-member setting widgets: Dedicated config widgets for code, prompt, text, query, notif, wait and probability members.
Member Settings Widgets.RunWorkflowPopup: Modeless popup that runs an entity's workflow on a file and lets the user pick from the resulting images.

Media Export.render_timeline_video: Renders the timeline to video by decoding active clips per frame and compositing them onto a canvas.
Media Export.render_timeline_audio: Mixes timeline audio clips over a time range into an output audio file.
Media Export.Audio offset alignment: Cross-correlates a reference and generated clip to compute the audio offset for syncing.
Media Export.Clip extraction: Extracts a clip's media segment for rendering or per-frame decoding.

Agent Member.ClaudeCode workflow member: An LlmMember subclass that drives the Claude Agent SDK (ClaudeSDKClient) as a workflow node, streaming assistant text, thinking, tool-use and tool-result blocks back into the chat.
Agent Member.Session resume: Captures the SDK session_id from the first assistant message and passes it as resume on subsequent turns so the conversation continues in the same Claude Code session.
Agent Member.Built-in tool gating: Builds the SDK tools allow-list from per-agent toggles for Bash/Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep/WebFetch/WebSearch (falling back to Bash if none are enabled).
Agent Member.Permission modes: Supports default, acceptEdits (auto-allows Write/Edit/NotebookEdit) and plan permission modes from config.
Agent Member.Interactive tool approval: Implements the SDK can_use_tool callback by emitting a tool_approval message into the chat and awaiting an asyncio future resolved by the user's Allow/Deny click.
Agent Member.AskUserQuestion routing: Intercepts the AskUserQuestion tool and returns the user's picked answers as updated_input to the SDK instead of a plain allow/deny.
Agent Member.Entity-backed SDK hooks: Converts configured hook rows (event + tool matcher + entity) into SDK HookMatchers whose callbacks run the referenced block/tool/agent workflow.
Agent Member.Interrupt on stop: Runs a background watcher that calls client.interrupt() when the workflow's stop flag is set, unblocking a turn stuck on a subprocess read.
Agent Member.Per-block message persistence: Saves each streamed block as its own DB row immediately so mid-stream context/branch switches don't lose thinking or tool history.

Chat Bubbles.ClaudeToolBubble: Renders a Claude tool-use payload compactly, resolving file paths relative to the current project cwd.
Chat Bubbles.ClaudeToolResultBubble: Renders a tool result block, collapsed/expandable on click.
Chat Bubbles.ToolApprovalBubble: Approval prompt bubble that renders tool-specific views — including coloured old/new diffs for Write/Edit — and resolves the pending approval future.
Chat Bubbles.QuestionBubble + OptionsPicker: Renders AskUserQuestion payloads as a keyboard- and mouse-navigable numbered option list with a free-text row, returning selections to the SDK.

Settings Widgets.ClaudeCodeSettings: Per-member tabbed settings covering Messages (model, max turns, permission mode, system message), Tools, Hooks and Voice.
Settings Widgets.Custom tools picker: DB-backed tree for attaching AgentPilot tools rows to a Claude Code member.
Settings Widgets.CC_User_Settings editor: File-backed editor for Claude Code's own settings.json across user / project / project-local scopes, written atomically with empty-key pruning.
Settings Widgets.General settings tab: Edits model, theme, effort level, output style, auto-updates, Co-Authored-By, always-thinking and cleanup period in settings.json.
Settings Widgets.Permissions tab: Edits the permissions block (allow/deny/ask rules) of settings.json.
Settings Widgets.Hooks tab: Two-way maps settings.json's nested hooks structure to a flat event/matcher/command table.
Settings Widgets.MCP & Advanced tab: Edits apiKeyHelper, forceLoginMethod, statusLine, enableAllProjectMcpServers and MCP server definitions.

Session Import.Claude Code transcript import: Reads ~/.claude JSONL session logs, groups them into resume chains per cwd, extracts messages and imports them as AgentPilot contexts.
Session Import.Project auto-creation: Creates a matching AgentPilot project row for each imported session's working directory.
Session Import.Import thread + delete: Runs the import on a QThread with progress, and offers bulk deletion of previously imported sessions.

Automation Backends.ComputerUseBrowser: Playwright-driven Chromium controller exposing screenshot, click, double/triple-click, type, key press, scroll, drag and mouse-move actions.
Automation Backends.Click ripple overlay: Injects a CSS keyframe ripple at the click point in the browser page so the user can see where the agent clicked.
Automation Backends.ComputerUseDesktop: PyAutoGUI-based full-desktop controller with the same action surface as the browser backend, operating on the real screen.
Automation Backends.Escape-key abort: Uses pynput to listen for Escape and abort an in-progress desktop automation run.
Automation Backends.Grace period: Inserts a configurable delay before each action so the user has time to intervene.
Automation Backends.execute_action dispatcher: Single entry point that maps an action dict (as emitted by a model) onto the corresponding backend method.
Automation Backends.Computer use loop: The workflow member drives a screenshot/action loop for computer-use tool calls against the desktop or browser.

UI.ComputerUseOverlay: Transparent, click-through full-screen glow on the screen edges indicating the agent is currently controlling the computer.
UI.ComputerUseSettings: Config fields for enabling computer use and setting the grace period and max iteration count.

Core.ProjectManager: BaseManager over the projects table handling load, add and delete of project rows.
Core.Application project bootstrap: Automatically creates an 'Application' project pointing at AgentPilot's own source path (SOURCE subdir when frozen) if it doesn't exist.
Core.Project types controller: Modules controller that discovers project-type classes under plugins.projects.gui.project_types.

Project Types.GeneralProject: Default project widget combining a path/type field row, a file tree rooted at the working dir, and bottom tabs.
Project Types.ApplicationProject: Specialised type that git-clones AgentPilot if the working dir is missing, then polls src/**/*.py mtimes every 2s and syncs changed files into the DB as modules.

Project Workspace Tabs.Chat tab: Project-scoped context tree (kind = PROJECT:<id>) with optional directory grouping and a 'chats that edited this file' filter mode.
Project Workspace Tabs.Plans tab: Reuses the standalone Plans page (markdown editor + Claude Code assistant + disk sync) scoped to the project.
Project Workspace Tabs.Block Maps tab: Maps blocks to file paths and provides a 'Bake' button that writes their rendered output into the project tree, refreshing the file tree afterwards.
Project Workspace Tabs.File tree context action: Adds a 'Show chats that edited' action to files, filtering the chat tree to conversations that touched that relative path.

Sync Utilities.resolve_module_type: Maps a source file's path to its module type and folder id via longest-prefix matching over registered type controllers, including cross-plugin paths.
Sync Utilities.sync_file_to_db: Upserts a changed source file back into the database as a non-baked module, skipping _-prefixed and base.py files.

Scheduling Engine.TasksDaemon: Async daemon that loads all SCHEDULED task rows and runs one long-lived loop per task uuid.
Scheduling Engine.Loop reconciliation: Starts, stops and restarts task loops to match current configs, only cancelling loops whose rrule actually changed so a reload can't perturb an imminent firing.
Scheduling Engine.rrule scheduling: Parses each task's iCal rrule, sleeps until the next occurrence and re-checks the clock before firing to avoid the early-wake double-fire bug.
Scheduling Engine.Task execution: Runs the task's stored workflow config through receive_workflow with kind='TASK', accumulating the streamed response.
Scheduling Engine.Error surfacing: Reports task failures through a warning message dialog rather than silently dying.
Scheduling Engine.Occurrence listing: Expands all tasks' rrules into per-day occurrence lists for the calendar view.

Management.TaskManager: BaseManager over the tasks table where each row's config is itself a workflow.
Management.Natural-language scheduling: Converts a free-form time expression to an rrule via the expression_to_time block, normalizes it back with time_to_expression, injects a DTSTART if missing, persists both and reloads the daemon.

UI.Page_Tasks_Settings: Main Tasks page joining a calendar view above the scheduled-tasks tree.
UI.CustomCalendar: Calendar widget that paints per-day task occurrence markers and supports jumping to today.
UI.DayTimelineWidget: Custom-painted day timeline where task occurrences can be hit-tested, dragged and snapped to a time grid, with a right-click context menu.
UI.AddTaskDialog: Dialog for creating a task at a chosen date/time with a recurrence selection, building the rrule from the inputs.
UI.Scheduled tasks tree: DB tree of scheduled tasks showing name, time expression and rrule, with a workflow-settings config widget that preserves rrule/time_expression across saves.

Video Studio.VideoStudio: Kdenlive-style multi-track video/audio editor registered for all video and audio extensions.
Video Studio.Timeline: QGraphicsScene/View timeline with draggable clip members, playhead, loop flags, snapping, zoom and a context menu.
Video Studio.Track controls: Per-track control panel with track config fields and a track context menu.
Video Studio.Lazy waveform/thumbnail loading: Background loaders that progressively render audio waveforms and video thumbnails onto timeline clips.
Video Studio.Preview panel: Compositing preview with per-clip playback workers, a master timeline clock, a threaded seek decoder and draggable/snapping preview items.
Video Studio.Project files: New/Open/Open Recent/Save/Save As over .agpm project files, with project settings (resolution and fps).
Video Studio.MediaCollectionPanel: Global filesystem-backed library of named scenes and characters, each holding labelled image files shared across all projects.
Video Studio.StoryboardPanel: Per-project ordered shot list of cards referencing a scene, a chosen still and a description, serialized into the project file.
Video Studio.Render dialog and worker: Configurable export (output path, codec/quality settings) run on a background worker with a progress dialog.
Video Studio.Effects/operations menus: Timeline context menu is populated dynamically from the registered effect and operation modules.

Image Studio.ImageStudio: Photoshop-style layer-based image editor registered for common raster formats.
Image Studio.Layers: Raster and image layers with visibility, opacity and blend modes, managed through a layers panel.
Image Studio.Canvas: QGraphicsView canvas compositing all layers, with a properties panel and fullscreen mode that hides the chrome.
Image Studio.Undo/redo history: Per-studio UndoHistory recording layer-pixel edits and document-structure changes, with mergeable actions and next-undo/redo labels.

Image Tools.Brush: Paints a stroke onto a temporary layer and composites it onto the current layer on release.
Image Tools.Eraser: Brush subclass that clears alpha along the stroke instead of painting.
Image Tools.Eyedropper: Picks the colour from the composited canvas at the clicked point as the foreground colour.
Image Tools.Fill: Fills at the clicked point with the current foreground colour.
Image Tools.Move: Drags the current layer by the offset from the press point.
Image Tools.CanvasTool base: Common press/move/release interface all canvas tools implement.

Text Studio.TextStudio: Single-file code/text editor registered for a wide range of text extensions, with autosave and a status bar showing position, selection, encoding and line endings.
Text Studio.Syntax highlighting: Builds an extension-to-highlighter map from the registered Highlighters modules and applies the matching one on open.
Text Studio.CodeEditor + line numbers: QPlainTextEdit-based editor with a line-number gutter.
Text Studio.Search dialog: Find/replace dialog over the open document.

AI Operations.BaseOperation: Base class for AI-powered media operations that receive the studio and the selected clips.
AI Operations.Audio inpaint: Replaces a section of audio with AI-generated content, using two draggable green region flags on the timeline and a non-modal dialog, uploading the source to the provider CDN and running the model on a background thread.
AI Operations.Provider timing adaptation: Resolves the correct start/end parameter names and value casts per provider/model for the inpaint request.
AI Operations.Audio transcribe: Chunks audio via ffmpeg, uploads and runs an STT model per chunk, normalizes segments across provider formats and writes an SRT subtitle file.
AI Operations.Video transcribe: Video-clip variant of the audio transcription operation.

Effects.Pitch (audio): Shifts an audio clip's pitch by a number of semitones.

Module Controllers.Studios controller: Registers studio modules and their associated file extensions.
Module Controllers.Per-domain controllers: Separate module controllers for image tools, image effects/operations, audio effects/operations, video operations, text operations and 3D operations.
Module Controllers.Page_Videos: Exposes the video studio as a top-level page.

Player.Page_Slopify: AI music generator page with a QMediaPlayer-backed player, artist tabs, playlist sidebar, track queue and transport bar.
Player.PlayerControls: Fixed-height transport bar with prev/play-pause/next, seekable progress slider and volume control.
Player.TrackQueue: Persistent generated-track table with Generate/Clear controls, concurrency and cover-ratio fields, showing in-flight pending rows.
Player.PlaylistSidebar / PlaylistTrackList: Spotify-style coloured playlist sidebar switching the content stack between the queue and a playlist's tracks.
Player.Playback control: Play by index, next/prev, toggle play-pause, stop, auto-advance on media-status change and duration back-fill into the track row.

Artists.ArtistCollection: Table of artist presets, each with its own config, avatar and priority weighting for generation picking.
Artists.Info tab: Artist metadata fields (top fields plus detail tabs) that are passed into generation as workflow params.
Artists.Songs tab: Per-artist song table synced from Genius, storing lyrics in each row's config.
Artists.Genius sync: Uses lyricsgenius with GENIUS_API_TOKEN to fetch up to 150 popularity-sorted songs per artist and upsert them with lyrics.
Artists.Generation tab: Embedded chattable workflow editor plus a header letting a shared default block be used instead, greying out the editor when active.

Generation.Generation loop: Timer-driven tick that spawns a new generation whenever in-flight plus unplayed tracks fall below the configured concurrency.
Generation.Cover mode: With a configurable probability, picks a random song by a different artist (filtering live/demo/mix/acoustic/instrumental variants) and feeds its name and lyrics into the workflow as a cover.
Generation.Workflow execution: Merges the artist's generation config into a workflow, runs it with kind='SLOPIFY' and the artist's info as params, and parses the JSON result.
Generation.Pending tracks and polling: Inserts placeholder rows into slopify_pending, stores the provider request id, then polls until the audio is ready — cleaning up stale rows with no request data.
Generation.Track completion: Downloads/records the finished audio file with a sanitized filename and promotes the pending row into a real queue track.

Market Data APIs.FinanceAPI base: Shared base class providing per-API asset/market existence lookups and last-update stamping.
Market Data APIs.BinanceAPI: Syncs Binance assets and markets, downloads and combines historical trade ZIP archives into H5 price files, and verifies H5 trade integrity with resumable, stoppable sync loops.
Market Data APIs.CoingeckoAPI: Syncs the CoinGecko coin list, per-coin metadata, market list and historical price series.
Market Data APIs.RevolutXAPI: Syncs trading pairs and pulls the user's own executed trades using Ed25519-signed request headers.
Market Data APIs.TwelveDataAPI: Async client for TwelveData covering asset lists, metadata, historical series, real-time prices, technical indicators, fundamentals and symbol search.
Market Data APIs.Finance daemon: Background daemon that periodically drives the registered API modules' sync routines against a separate finance database.
Market Data APIs.API module controller: Modules controller that discovers and registers finance API modules so they appear in the settings sync table.

HDF5 Storage.PriceFile: Context-managed wrapper over an .h5 file holding trades, per-interval OHLC and per-interval indicator datasets.
HDF5 Storage.Interval generation: Rolls base trade/OHLC data up into candles for 1m through 1Y intervals, resuming from the last stored candle and reprocessing the incomplete tail.
HDF5 Storage.Indicator datasets: Generates and reads indicator series stored alongside OHLC under indicators/<interval>/<name>.
HDF5 Storage.Dataset helpers: Creation, chunked appending, first/last cell lookup, binary search by unix timestamp, timestamp normalization and H5 file introspection.
HDF5 Storage.Path/naming helpers: Sanitizes API/market names into deterministic H5 file paths.

Operations.Operation base: Abstract streaming operation interface with an on_datapoint hook and an embedded config-fields widget.
Operations.SMA: Simple moving average operation computed incrementally over incoming datapoints.
Operations.EMA: Exponential moving average operation computed incrementally over incoming datapoints.

UI Pages and Widgets.Page_Finance: Main tabbed finance page backed by a dedicated finance.db SQLite connector.
UI Pages and Widgets.Portfolio tab: Portfolio overview tab intended to display asset allocation as a pie chart.
UI Pages and Widgets.Assets tab: Asset table ordered by balance, with per-asset History (trades / deposits-withdrawals) and Chart sub-tabs.
UI Pages and Widgets.Users tab: Fund member table computing each user's share count from their deposits and withdrawals.
UI Pages and Widgets.Trades tab: Flat listing of all recorded trades with dates, exchange and sold/bought amounts.
UI Pages and Widgets.DepWiths tab: Deposit/withdrawal ledger with per-row asset balances at the time of the transaction.
UI Pages and Widgets.Settings tab: Finance settings fields plus a table of finance API modules with per-module sync buttons.
UI Pages and Widgets.ChartWidget: pyqtgraph candlestick chart with x-axis-only wheel zoom, auto y-scaling and indicator sub-plots driven by a PriceFile.
UI Pages and Widgets.FundMapWidget: Interactive graphics-view map of exchanges with a time-scrubbing slider and a holdings table.
UI Pages and Widgets.Marriage algorithm: Matches unmarried withdrawals to deposits at a different exchange by same asset, amount within 2% and within 24 hours, idempotently linking both rows.
UI Pages and Widgets.H5Studio: HDF5 studio (registered for .h5 files) with a lazy-loaded group/dataset tree, paginated dataset table viewer with slicing and cell editing, a metadata panel and a chart tab.
UI Pages and Widgets.Asset/balance helpers: Functions to compute total portfolio value and per-asset balances/prices at an arbitrary unix time, resolve linked assets and convert prices between assets.

Page.Page_Embroidery: A joined config page pairing an image-processing parameter form with a live preview label that re-renders on every field change.

Subject Selection.Auto background removal: Runs rembg with a selectable model (e.g. u2net) to isolate the subject and fill the background with a chosen colour.
Subject Selection.Point-based selection: Lets the user click points on the preview to seed/refine the mask, with click-to-remove of the nearest point and a clear-points button.
Subject Selection.Mask invert and fill: Supports inverting the computed mask and choosing the RGBA fill colour applied to the masked-out region.

Image Processing.Enhancers: Brightness, contrast, saturation and sharpness adjustment sliders applied via PIL ImageEnhance.
Image Processing.Filters: Gaussian blur radius and odd-sized median filter for noise smoothing before quantization.
Image Processing.Posterize: Reduces each channel to N bits to flatten tonal range.
Image Processing.Colour quantization: Reduces the image to a chosen number of colours using a selectable quantize method (e.g. median cut) with optional dithering and k-means refinement.
Image Processing.Small-region removal: Union-find 4-connected component labelling that merges colour regions below a pixel-count threshold into their neighbours.
Image Processing.Outline: Draws an outline of configurable thickness around colour regions to emulate stitch borders.
Image Processing.Coordinate mapping: Maps preview-widget clicks back to original image coordinates so selection points survive resizing.

Scraping Pipeline.GrouponScraper: Orchestrates a full run in phases — division discovery, sitemap enumeration, browse pass, detail pass — with cancellation and progress callbacks.
Scraping Pipeline.Sitemap enumeration: Fetches the sitemap index and streams (loc, lastmod) deal URLs per shard for the local/goods/getaways kinds, backing off when throttled.
Scraping Pipeline.Division discovery: Derives the set of division slugs and their category slugs from sitemap shard URLs.
Scraping Pipeline.Browse pass: Visits division (and division/category) listing pages and harvests every deal card.
Scraping Pipeline.Detail pass: Visits individual deal pages for deals still awaiting a detail scrape, newest sitemap entries first.

Browser and Parsing.GrouponBrowser: Headless Chromium wrapper holding one Playwright context per concurrent worker, with a context-recycling pool and navigation timeouts.
Browser and Parsing.Stealth and block detection: Injects stealth JS and raises GrouponBlocked when Groupon responds with a bot-protection status.
Browser and Parsing.Infinite-scroll settling: Scrolls a listing page until the deal-card count stays stable for several rounds before extracting.
Browser and Parsing.Card parser: Decodes embedded deal-card payloads — base64 options blobs, minor-unit prices with currency exponents, type-keyed body sections — into flat queryable fields.
Browser and Parsing.Permalink extraction: Derives the canonical deal slug from a Groupon deal URL.

Storage and UI.GrouponManager: Manager defining the deals/divisions tables, upserting deals by permalink and divisions with their categories, and exposing counts, enabled divisions and pending-deal queues.
Storage and UI.Scrape lifecycle: Starts a scrape as a background task with progress reporting and supports cancelling an in-flight run.
Storage and UI.Deals tab: Scrape control fields (kinds, max deals, concurrency, which passes to run) above a read-only searchable deals tree with a raw config/metadata JSON dump.
Storage and UI.Divisions tab: Read-only division tree with a per-division enabled toggle and a 'Discover divisions' button that runs a divisions-only scrape.

Connector.MysqlConnector: Thread-safe MySQL connector built on a mysql-connector pool with auto-reconnect and retry logic.
Connector.Pooled connection context: Context manager that leases a pooled connection, retries on failure and returns it cleanly.
Connector.Query helpers: get_results (rows/dict/list shapes), execute with transaction handling returning affected rows, and get_scalar with optional JSON parsing.
Connector.define_table: Creates/ensures a table and its declared relations exist.

Connector.PostgresConnector: Thread-safe PostgreSQL connector built on psycopg2 pooling with auto-reconnect and retry logic.
Connector.Pooled connection context: Context manager leasing a pooled connection with retry handling.
Connector.Query helpers: execute returning the last inserted id for INSERTs, get_results with multiple return shapes, and get_scalar with optional JSON loading.
Connector.define_table: Creates/ensures a table and its declared relations exist.
